scope: Second text/design pass after content revision; same assistant, not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Nina locates and hands over the book before Iris looks for her pen. The English has been reviewed as short beginner utterances, not as a claim of authentic unscripted dialogue.

transferQuality.evidence: A03 contrasts grammatically possible object nouns; A06 recalls a location question from the other role. Evidence is same-session bounded recall, not a proficiency certificate.

overallCoherence.evidence: Nina locates and hands over the book before Iris looks for her pen. Teaching, selection feedback and the terminal task retain the Lesson outcome and played role.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static flow review: optional help, typed fallback and per-option explanations reduce dead ends. No real microphone, perception or learner test was performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual/prosody review.
